**STEP 1 - Scene:** A airline-style tray meal: roast chicken with roast baby potatoes, a slice of dark fruit or chocolate cake, and mixed vegetables (carrot, sweetcorn, broccoli). A glass of water and a milky drink are on the tray but are not plated food, so I exclude them.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Main paper plate, about 24 cm diameter, area ≈ 452 cm². The cake sits on a side plate of about 16 cm (≈ 201 cm²). The vegetables are in a bowl of about 17 cm (≈ 227 cm²).

**STEP 3 - Items:** Roast chicken pieces (thigh/drumstick and sliced breast), roast baby potatoes (about 4-5), dark fruit/chocolate cake slice, mixed carrot/corn/broccoli. No visible sauce or oil pool.

**STEP 4 - Area:**
- Chicken: about 18% of the main plate, ≈ 81 cm²
- Potatoes: about 15% of the main plate, ≈ 68 cm²
- Cake: about 15% of the side plate, ≈ 30 cm²
- Vegetables: about 35% of the bowl, ≈ 80 cm²

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Chicken: 81 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 162 ml
- Potatoes: 68 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 170 ml
- Cake: 30 cm² × 3.5 cm ≈ 105 ml
- Vegetables: 80 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 160 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Chicken: 162 × 0.95 ≈ 155 g
- Potatoes: 170 × 0.9 ≈ 150 g
- Cake: 105 × 0.6 ≈ 60 g (dense cake, so above the loaf value)
- Vegetables: 160 × 0.6 ≈ 96 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Chicken with skin, cooked: ~220 kcal/100 g × 155 g ≈ 341 kcal
- Roast potatoes: ~130 kcal/100 g × 150 g ≈ 195 kcal
- Fruit/chocolate cake: ~380 kcal/100 g × 60 g ≈ 228 kcal
- Cooked mixed vegetables: ~45 kcal/100 g × 96 g ≈ 43 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 461 g and ≈ 807 kcal. That fits a full airline-style main course with a dessert slice. The estimate carries wide uncertainty, roughly ±25%.
